clusters.method: mutual k-nearest-neighbour graph (k=12, cosine) + Louvain modularity (networkx)

families.label: Look
families.definition: objects that sit close together in the photo + title space of the map (mutual 12-nearest-neighbour graph, Louvain communities, minimum 40 objects)

families.label: Type
families.definition: objects the museums and the codebook give the same device family or object type

families.label: Morphology
families.definition: objects whose outlines have the same shape: pose-free width and bend profile, rotation-invariant Fourier magnitudes and dimensionless scalars, clustered on the study's combined shape distance

families.label: Use
families.definition: objects with the same codebook working function (grasping, cutting, measuring, storing, …)

surg_map.method: the most frequent principle the T-030 codebook gives the catalogue records that carry both the Medicine tag and a principle; the surgical instruments join that principle in one lane, "Medical practice", and are never assigned a principle by hand

embedding.encoder: SigLIP 2 ViT-B-16-256 (webli), photograph + title, same settings as the science embeddings
embedding.fusion: siglip2_b16+siglip2_b16_text, z-scored cosines summed; museum-centred within domain
embedding.map: UMAP n_neighbors=15 min_dist=0.1 cosine seed 7 on PCA-50

layout.pipeline: L2-normalise → PCA-50 → UMAP (cosine, spectral init, seed 7)

sweep_choice.rule: highest k-NN preservation (k = 10), then trustworthiness, then continuity, then the smaller n_neighbors
sweep_choice.name: UMAP n_neighbors=15, min_dist=0.1

layout.note: The 2-D layout is for viewing only; the groups by closeness are found in the full space. A sub-collection is laid out on its own in the photo + title space, and no groups are outlined there.

params.similarity: exp(-shape distance); the shape distance blocks are median-normalised

landing.rule: a group appears on the landing page only if it passes the naming rule, crosses at least three museums, has at least 60 objects, is not a paper or photography artefact, and has no catalogue record with a broken date (a date outside 1450–2035); genuine ancient dates in the curated releases are kept
landing.date_rule: catalogue records only, broken dates only (T-042)
